method: Each query was routed by a haiku agent given the full 29-entry roster (19 skills across the technical-writer, principal-engineer, and multi-agent-review plugins, plus 10 real distractor skills) and asked which single skill it would consult first. Proxy measurement of description quality, not of live-session triggering. Routing agents must run with worktree isolation and router-not-executor framing: task-shaped query text has been executed by an agent once.

reviewing-technical-prose.note: rp06 (reviewing a postmortem for tone) routes stably to writing-postmortems; accepted as a correct alternate landing since its cross-references route onward. Observation: essay-review queries also land on reviewing-technical-prose because nothing in the roster owns non-technical prose; mild over-trigger, tolerated.

documenting-legacy-codebases.note: Measured 2026-08-22 against a 39-entry roster (29 real skills across four plugins, 10 distractors): the four dl queries plus the three overlap-risk siblings (tw01, tw02, tw05). All four dl queries routed as intended, including the investigation phrasing and the boundary probe (fresh endpoint docs stayed on technical-writing). tw01 and tw05 kept their prior destinations. tw02 (write up how the sync pipeline works) moved to documenting-legacy-codebases; accepted as a correct alternate landing since documenting an existing system is this skill's territory and it loads the core as required background.
